summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository. Source: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType (no existing values changed) and extended ControlCode with a (ControlType, str) tuple; registered the title sequence "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" in CONTROL_CODES_FORMAT and added Control.title(title) in rich/control.py; added Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor in rich/console.py, returning True when written to a terminal and False otherwise; added a SET_WINDOW_TITLE dispatch in rich/_windows_renderer.py that calls term.set_title with the control's second item. Docs: added an Unreleased "Added" CHANGELOG bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (console, skipped on win32), test_control_title (control), and test_control_set_window_title (Windows renderer with mocked wrapper). Not run: per instructions, no tests, Black, or repository code were executed, so formatting and test results are unverified. Nothing was committed.
